# Recipes

<!-- This page is generated by scripts/generate-recipes.py from recipes/*.json. Do not edit it by hand. -->

Recipes are tested ways to serve Hub models on Amazon SageMaker AI with the Hugging Face vLLM Deep Learning Container (DLC). Each one pins the container, the instance, and the engine settings, and comes with the validation and benchmark results Hugging Face measured on a real SageMaker endpoint. Pick a model, compare its recipes, and deploy one in a click from the AWS console, with one AWS CLI command, or from Python.

11 models, 11 recipes, last updated 2026-11-25. Read [How recipes are measured](./methodology) for the workloads and metrics, and [Deploy a recipe](./deploy-a-recipe) for a step-by-step walkthrough.
